lines.text: Sprocket here. If it's broken, I fix it.
This old tractor just needed one little part.

video.description: The piglet is SPROCKET: brown tool belt with a gold buckle and two brown pouches, silver wrench in one hoof, no goggles. The tractor is blue and in good condition.

beats.action: Sprocket faces the camera and chats cheerfully with small proud gestures of the wrench.
He turns and trots over to the blue tractor behind him.
He works on the tractor's engine with the wrench, a couple of tiny sparks.
The tractor shudders, a puff of grey smoke pops from the exhaust stack and the headlights flick on while he watches.
He turns to the camera with a big proud grin and throws both hooves up.
